title: hieracium pallidum subsp. leucothecum
intro: Hieracium pallidum subsp. leucothecum, commonly known as a type of hawkweed, is a plant species that belongs to the dandelion family. This plant has been traditionally used in herbal medicine to treat various health conditions due to its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Hieracium pallidum subsp. leucothecum include soothing digestive issues, reducing fever, and acting as a diuretic. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and sesquiterpene lactones, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
